title: Dog Night, 2019 · before
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The night before twenty years: the outline in the gravel, the bin, the sign with seven dark, and Wood tired in a way the strip has stopped hiding — sitting down on the curb in the alley with the pup in his lap, the mark in the margin smaller than it's been. Nothing happens. That's the strip.

panels.composition: The alley at night. The bin, the outline in the gravel, the sign with seven letters dark. WOOD sitting on the curb. The PUP in his lap.
